reason: Tab. 12.2 (from p.76) is the only unit-process raw-data table in the report: 'Unit process raw data, example for crude oil and natural gas production', printed for one country (CA) as the exemplar of the whole family of country-specific onshore/offshore oil-and-gas production datasets, of which this dataset is one. The country-specific numbers themselves are not printed per country — only the parameters that feed them (energy demand Tab. 8.1-8.7, flaring Tab. 9.1, methane Tab. 9.3, produced water Tab. 10.1-10.5, spills Tab. 10.6-10.8) — so this table gives the exchange list and the order of magnitude, not this country's exact values. The range runs to p.79 because Tab. 12.2 is explicitly 'part 1' and continues past its first page.
